A damaged item is different because it is not a standard change-of-mind return. For online orders, once you log in we can review your order details plus photos or a short video of the damage and help with the right outcome. If it was bought in-store or via Click & Collect, the local store handles it, as Toyworld stores are independently owned and operated.
